user.title: Kyber — Setup
user.description: Select your AI task entity and configure token limit and startup behaviour.

data_description.max_daily_tokens: Shared by the chat panel and MCP. Once it is used up, requests are refused until midnight.
data_description.chat_timeout: How long the chat panel waits for an answer before giving up. Raise this for slow local models (e.g. Ollama on modest hardware).
data_description.narrator_ai_task_entity_id: Used for batching and small tasks such as entity narration. A smaller, cheaper model works well here. Defaults to the chat model.

data.openai_base_url: API Base URL (leave blank for OpenAI default)

data_description.cloud_provider: Select a cloud AI provider. Provider credentials appear after saving and re-opening options.
data_description.openai_base_url: Custom API base URL (e.g. Groq or OpenRouter endpoint). Leave blank for OpenAI default.
data_description.azure_endpoint: Your Azure OpenAI resource endpoint URL

data.run_initial_analyze: Run 1 initial analyze pass after install
data.deep_learning_interval_days: Deep learning: run every N days

data_description.area_assignment_mode: Suggest or auto-apply area assignments to entities mentioned in conversation.
data_description.label_assignment_mode: Suggest or auto-apply kyber: device-type labels to entities in conversation.

data.enable_debug_views: Enable debug views (Kyber Debug sidebar + per-turn debug tools)
data.enable_mcp_in_chat: Use external MCP servers in chat
data.mcp_allow_state_changes: MCP can change state of home
data.max_requests_per_minute: Max requests per minute per user (0 = unlimited)

data_description.enable_mcp: Registers the MCP endpoint at POST /api/kyber/mcp so external AI clients (ChatGPT, Claude and others) can use Kyber.
data_description.enable_mcp_in_chat: Lets the chat model call the tools of the MCP servers listed below.
data_description.mcp_allow_state_changes: Allows MCP clients to switch devices and set values directly (hass_turn_on, hass_turn_off, hass_toggle, hass_set_value). When off, they can only read.
data_description.mcp_client_servers: A JSON list with one entry per server: name, url and token.
data_description.max_requests_per_minute: Applies to the chat panel and MCP.
